u0: Initial state: the ball still blocks the cell in front of the locked door and the agent holds nothing relevant. Objective: reach the blocker ball and pick it up (or otherwise clear its cell) to make blocker_moved true; do not go for the key first, since the required order is ball before key.
u1: The blocker has been moved off the door cell, so the door cell is reachable, but the agent does not yet carry the matching key. Objective: locate and pick up the key whose color matches the locked door to make has_door_key true; if the ball gets dropped back in front of the door, progress reverts to u0.
u2: The agent carries the matching door key and the ball is still clear of the door. Objective: face the door from the accessible cell in front of it and toggle it to make door_open true; dropping or otherwise losing the key while the door stays closed fires key_lost and sends progress back to u1.
u3: The door is unlocked and open, connecting the two rooms; the key is no longer required and may be dropped. Objective: enter the far room, find the box named in the mission, and pick it up so target_picked_up becomes true and the episode ends.
u4: Terminal success state: the agent carries the mission's designated box and the episode has ended. No further objective remains; all subsequent steps stay in this final state.
